scope: Exact current source/seed managed references and one finite download attempt plus one retry per unique original legacy inventory source_url. No application/repository/hosting changes.
legacy_public_path_mapping: Copy contents of legacy-uploads/ to dist/public/wp-content/uploads/ preserving relative paths.
claim_limit: Managed referenced files are bundled where verified. Only successfully retrieved legacy source originals are bundled. Resized variants and unavailable original media are not claimed as backed up. External URL source strings are unchanged.

portable_media_url_map.format: Flat JSON object: full original external URL string -> relative public /wp-content/uploads/<bundled authoritative source filename>.
portable_media_url_map.operation: No application/source rewriting performed. Main package can replace exact URL substrings in packaged source only using this map.
portable_media_url_map.limitations: Derivative mapping preserves media identity, not resized/cropped byte equivalence. Explicit original_upload_url metadata may map unscaled upload to bundled -scaled source. No derivative files were downloaded. Unmatched external sources remain remote dependencies.
